_about: Plans and prices for the whole website, in one place. node scripts/site.mjs writes them into every page's <!-- site:plans --> block. While published is false, prices show as 'Price to be announced'. Stripe holds the amount actually charged (STRIPE_PRICE_* in the platform), so change both together. Proposed by the maintainer on 30 Oct for review with Vinay (DEC-1, Tenwise/tenwise-platform#87, still open): Reader $5/month or $50/year, Plus $12/month or $120/year.

plans.name: Reader
plans.for: Your feeds and your library, hosted for you, with AI from your own key or your browser.
features: Feeds, blogs and Google News searches, refreshed when you open Tenwise
A dense list or a grid, and a calm docked reader
Saves with notes, highlights and collections
APA citations; export to Markdown, HTML and OPML
A daily digest email of what's new
AI with your own key, or Gemini Nano in Chrome
Read, save and highlight on your phone
Download your whole library, any time

plans.name: Plus
plans.for: For people who turn their reading into something they send: a weekly update, a client note, a newsletter.
features: Recurring briefs, drafted from your sources and the notes you choose
Every claim linked to the passage that supports it
Unsupported or conflicting claims flagged before you send
Approve, export, or share a brief by link
Tenwise AI included each month, no key needed
Studio newsletters and PDFs; Send to NotebookLM
